name: Stir-Fried Farro With Garlicky Kale and Poached Egg

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling

instructions.primary_message: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and add farro. Lower heat and simmer until farro is tender but not mushy, about 20 minutes (different brands of farro can have significantly different cooking times, so start checking at 20 minutes, but be prepared to simmer longer). Drain and set aside.

Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add shallots and cook until softened, about 4 minutes. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds longer. Add kale and cook, tossing, until wilted, about 4 minutes. Add farro and vinegar and toss until farro is warmed through. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide kale and grains into 4 bowls. Top each with an egg, seasoning with salt and pepper. Garnish with shaved Parmesan, if using. Serve, passing chili sauce at the table, if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: breakfast, brunch, egg, farro, grain, kale

description: Ditch the hastily-toasted bagel and thrown-together bowl of ceral and choose a healthy combination of grains and greens—and, of course, an egg—with this colorful and tasty breakfast recipe.
notes: Optional or for serving: Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, for shaving (optional); Chile sauce, for serving (optional)
author: Emily and Matt Clifton
